notes.title: Now easier
notes.content:
Two weeks after the demo's release, players agree that boxing mechanics are difficult to control and that the overall difficulty of the game is too high.

A new version of the demo has just been released with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Improved boxing controls.
[*] Redesign of certain levels to clarify the path the player should take.
[*] A new "easy mode" that reduces the overall difficulty of the game. Enable it in the "Settings" menu.
[/list]
